title: Bleve build info must record mapped selectable fields, not just features
answers: Why does the index fall back to store scan for a field it actually has
Index built with an old Grafana version refuses filters it should answer
body: Root cause/convention: an index's build info must list the selectable fields it was actually built with (info.SelectableFields), read once into bleveIndex.mappedSelectableFields at open time in pkg/storage/unified/search/bleve.go:newBleveIndex, since the mapped set cannot change while the index is open. An empty list is read as "this index maps no selectable fields" (triggers refusal) rather than "unknown" — so an older index format that maps fields without recording them would be wrongly treated as mapping none, causing unnecessary store-scan fallback (safe but slower) rather than a wrong silent-empty-result (unsafe). When changing what an index can map, the build-info writer and this read-at-open logic must stay in sync.

Index performance suffers when it forgets mapped selectable fields
Bleve index doesn't use field mappings from earlier versions
search: Bleve index build info must record the actual selectable fields that were mapped (info.SelectableFields), read into bleveIndex.mappedSelectableFields at open time in pkg/storage/unified/search/bleve.go:newBleveIndex. An empty list is interpreted as 'this index maps no selectable fields' (triggers store-scan fallback) rather than 'unknown,' so older index formats that map fields without recording them would be wrongly treated as mapping none instead of producing a silent unsafe empty result. When changing index mapping capabilities, the build-info writer and the read-at-open logic in newBleveIndex and getBuildInfo must stay synchronized. Applies to pkg/storage/unified/search bleve index build-info handling and selectable-field tracking.
